Six Regional Archive document types were identified without exact English equivalents: expediente de información pública, padrón de habitantes, libro de actas, diligencia, oficio de remisión, and bando. A literal translation may conceal legal or archival distinctions, so the Spanish label will always be retained as the source term.

The English version will use a functional label accompanied by a short note when necessary. For example, “padrón de habitantes” will be represented as “municipal register of residents,” with a note explaining that it is a specific administrative register. “Diligencia” will not have one universal translation: either “official certification note” or “procedural record” will be selected according to context.

Separate classes will not be created merely because of language variation. Each type will have one shared identifier, preferred ES/EN labels, the source label, and examples. Yara will review the proposals, and Eva will validate that the definitions preserve the archival meaning.
